verdict.rationale: Semgrep ships a headless CLI that installs via pipx or uv. `semgrep scan` runs without login and `semgrep ci` supports SARIF export and `--dry-run`. First-party guides cover CI jobs for explicitly supported providers, triggered on push and PR/MR events, plus pre-commit hooks and a platform API. A Microsoft practitioner independently corroborates building an automated pipeline on Semgrep's SARIF output. Missing for 10: documented exit-code/build-failure gating behavior for CI pipelines.
